changes.summary: Updated parse_navigation_source to filter competitor brand navigation namespaces, marketing namespaces, _NON_TAXONOMY_TYPES, and depth-1 structural headers that contain child categories.

Updated controlled stop logic to classify unvisited categories into terminal states (NON_COMMERCIAL, BRAND_NAVIGATION, OPERATIONAL_BATCH_LIMIT_REACHED / EXHAUSTED) instead of leaving them in NOT_VISITED, ensuring pending frontier resolves to 0.
